overview.description: DESYNC is an execution protocol that extends Tendermint by introducing a leader worker execution model with VRF-based leader election, parallel batch execution, and verifiable receipts. It ensures deterministic state transitions, supports fraud proofs, and enforces slashing for invalid behavior.

client.role: Submit signed transactions via Tendermint RPC.

validator.role: Run Tendermint consensus + Desync ABCI app. Participate in VRF commit/reveal, verify receipts, finalize state root.

desync_abci.role: Batch creation, assignment to workers, receipt verification, commit of final AppHash to Tendermint.

worker.role: Execute batches deterministically, produce receipts + proofs, sign results.

monitor.role: Verify receipts off-chain and submit fraud evidence if inconsistencies are found.

election: Validators compute hash_commit and broadcast VRFCommit
Validators broadcast VRFReveal with revealed_hash + proof
All validators verify proofs and compute weighted_hash = revealed_hash / stake
tx_submission: Client signs and broadcasts Transaction to Tendermint RPC
Tendermint proposer includes txs in block
ABCI DeliverTx buffers txs in deterministic block order
batch_execution: Leader creates batches from blockTxList deterministically
Workers execute batches deterministically, compute post_state_root, produce proofs
verification_and_commit: Leader applies state roots sequentially to derive FinalStateRoot
Leader commits FinalStateRoot as AppHash in ABCI Commit()
fraud_proof: If mismatch found, Evidence is submitted as DeliverTx
ABCI verifies counter_proof, slashes worker, and reassigns batch or re-executes

rules.determinism: All workers must produce identical results given same inputs
rules.slashing: Workers producing invalid receipts lose stake
rules.fraud_proofs: Validators can challenge receipts with Evidence

timeouts.leader_timeout: If no heartbeat > heartbeat_interval * threshold, backup takes over
timeouts.worker_timeout: If no BatchResult by worker_execution_timeout, reassign batch

security.byzantine_fault_tolerance: Safe if < 1/3 workers or validators are Byzantine
security.proof_integrity: SMT proofs guarantee state update correctness
security.liveness: Leader rotation and Tendermint consensus ensure progress
